summary: Quick e2e test. Backend: 29/31 pytest pass (auth, profile/onboarding, weather, AI suggestions, favorites, history rating, groups/messages/votes, notifications, assistant SSE, photo upload + avatar GET, privacy 8 langs, PWA assets). Frontend: all requested flows pass - register->4-step onboarding (10 hobbies + reorder)->Home; demo login -> AI suggestions (6 cards) -> favorite + done -> Saved favorites/history + thumb up; Map renders 9 markers; group create/text/proposal/vote; second user joins via code and gets 'Nuova proposta' toast in ~9s; assistant streams reply; photo upload updates avatar (/api/avatar/..); language ar sets dir=rtl; Donate shows PayPal link (giuseppenoe@libero.it) + IBAN.

minor.issue: Brute-force lock not effective behind k8s ingress: key uses request.client.host (ingress pod IP varies per request), so after 5 bad logins the correct password still returns 200 instead of 429. Use X-Forwarded-For first IP (or lock by email only).
Arabic content returned but <html> lacks dir="rtl" (privacy.py privacy_html). Add dir='rtl' when lang=='ar'.

issues: AI reply shows raw markdown (**bold**, '- ' lists) - render with react-markdown or strip
Page title ('Il tuo assistente IA', group name) is clipped/blurred under the sticky top bar

Dates shown as 11/2/2026 (US style) in Italian locale - use toLocaleDateString(lang)
Demo user avatar in header renders as empty pink circle (no initials/image)
